title: Move GitHub support links to sidebar
summary: Public GitHub support links now live in a sidebar App Support section with icon-led pills instead of the shared footer.
changes: Move GitHub, Open an issue, and Discussions links from the shared footer into a new App Support section at the bottom of the left sidebar.
Show App Support below Log out for signed-in users and after the theme toggle for guests.
Style each support link as a pill with a Lucide icon and a hover lift effect.
Keep the Change Log Hub Feedback and source block unchanged.
version_rationale: Patch release: relocates existing public GitHub links within the shared layout without changing URLs or access rules.
validation: PHPUnit ChangeLogPageTest and HealthAndThemeTest for sidebar App Support placement and footer removal.
Verified guest and authenticated layouts render the three external GitHub links in the sidebar.
known_limitations: Change Log Hub still shows a separate Feedback and source link group in the page hero.
Privacy, cookies, help, and terms routes remain planned under issue #123.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore footer GitHub links.
provenance: Defined by MyAPES Account issue #185 and pull request #186.
